item.title: American Society of Plastic Surgeons advises its members not to perform “sex change” operations on children
item.description: The decision places the ASPS in uncharted territory. It is the first major U.S. professional medical association to explicitly tighten its recommendations on pediatric gender-affirming surgery, grounding the shift in what it describes as insufficient evidence to support a favorable risk–benefit balance for children and adolescents. item.title: Gender ideology: UN prepares to define new “gender crimes”
